nightly-eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval run 2026-03-18T03:00Z detected quality regression for rwd-3b-q8_0
nightly-eval-bot: metrics vs baseline (rwd-3b-fp32): toxicity +18%, repetition-rate +35%, factual-hallucination +12% (95% CI)
nightly-eval-bot: top failing prompt buckets: knowledge-recall-long-context, creative-writing, multi-step reasoning
nightly-eval-bot: sample failure (trunc/prompt redacted):
```
User: Summarize the following event and list the people involved.
Model: "He was killed. He was killed. He was killed." ... repeats 14x then adds an explicit slur in final sentence.
```
Priya: :eyes: Is this aligned with the quant rollout from last night?
Liam: We applied `quant-profile:v2-compact` to rwd-3b at ~1759000100 and rolled a small kernel tweak to attention KV cleanup at ~1759005000. Could be either.
Samir: Can we get the exact prompts that triggered the repetition loop? The example above looks like a generation loop rather than a content drift.
nightly-eval-bot: Attaching 5 top examples (inline). Example 2 shows deterministic loop starting at token 24, logits collapse on token 25.
Eva: Repro steps I ran locally: `rwd-infer --model rwd-3b-q8_0 --quant-config v2-compact --temp 0.2 --max-tokens 200 --dump-logits /tmp/logits.npz` -> I hit the same loop on example #2.
Priya: Good repro. Can you also run fp32 baseline? we need to confirm it's a quant/regression.
Eva: fp32 run (rwd-3b-fp32) on same prompt produced a coherent summary with no repetition. So seems quant/exec path-related.
Liam: Noted. Two immediate hypotheses: quant clipping causing logits underflow -> repeats; or KV cache bug (recent attention free) causing decoder state reset -> repetitive tokens.
Maria: Quick ask: how widespread is toxicity spike vs just a few prompts? If it's only certain prompts that lead to repetition it might amplify toxicity because the loop concatenates a toxic fragment.
nightly-eval-bot: Toxicity spike concentrated on the same failing examples where repetition occurs. Outside those buckets toxicity is flat.
Samir: Could be beam/greedy fallback differences too. Any change to sampling defaults?
Liam: No sampling default changes. But `quant-profile:v2-compact` uses asymmetric int8 for some attention matmuls and introduces per-channel scaling for some weights. I can roll a canary with `v2-compact-no-asym` to isolate.
Priya: Ops constraints?
ops-bot: Canary rollout OK on one GPU pod, but capacity limited for larger reruns. Rolling back is possible but will need approval if we expand to production.
Eva: For triage I'll run a logits-diff between q8 and fp32. If we see logit collapse (top1 prob -> 0.97 repeatedly) that's a clear quant clipping sign.
Samir: Also request: check KV indices around the loop start. If KV keys reset or sequence positions jump that's KV bug. Add packet of `kv-meta` to debug dump.
Liam: I remember a recent change to free unused KV buffers when sequence length < 64 to reduce memory. That landed in commit `c4d2b9f`. Could interact with quant path edge cases.
Priya: Actionable plan: 1) Eva reproduce and dump logits + kv-meta (owner: Eva, ETA 1h) 2) Liam run canary with `v2-compact-no-asym` and run nightly eval subset (owner: Liam, ETA 2h) 3) Samir run prompt-bucket diff to confirm whether prompts were recently added (owner: Samir, ETA 30m) 4) If quant suspected, roll back quant profile for prod after safety checks (owner: Priya, decision after results).
Maria: Also add a safety rule to nightly-evals: if repetition-rate > 20% trigger auto-suspend of the quant profile until investigation.
Priya: +1 for a short lived safety gate. Samir can you add a guard to the eval job?
Samir: Yep I'll add a quick check and a slack webhook alert.
Eva: Repro logs: attached snippet ->
```
# logits snippet (q8)
step 24: topk probs [0.72, 0.05, 0.02,...]
step 25: topk probs [0.95, 0.01, 0.00,...] -> same token repeated
# kv-meta: seq_pos jumped from 24 -> 0 at loop start
```
Priya: kv-meta jump is suspicious. If sequence position resets we'll see decoder re-read same context and loop.
Liam: That aligns with the KV cleanup heuristic I mentioned. I'll revert that micro-optim next and run canary.
ops-bot: Started rollback job `rollback/kv-free-fix` on canary pod.
Maria: If rollback fixes loops but quant still produces slightly worse factuality we can iterate on quant offline. Prioritize stability first.
Priya: Agreed. We'll pause any further quant rollouts until this is triaged.
Samir: I've added the eval guard and hooked the webhook to `#eng-ml` for visibility.
Eva: After reverting KV change and running q8 run on the canary, loop disappeared for the 5 failing examples. Still running longer sweep.
Liam: That's good signal. I'll open a PR to revert the KV heuristic and add a regression test (replay failing prompts with kv boundary conditions).
Priya: Thanks team. Next updates in this thread once the sweep finishes. :thumbsup:
Maria: Filing a postmortem ticket and linking logs -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/RI-2026-572
nightly-eval-bot: NOTE: investigation labels added: `regression/quant_path`, `regression/kv-cache`
Priya: Closing checklist: reproduce (done), narrow root cause (KV heuristic + quant interaction), rollback on canary (in progress), add test + safety gate (in progress). Owners assigned above.
Liam: :white_check_mark:
Samir: :rocket:
Eva: :eyes:
